# Copilot instructions — Energy Pool brand assets

## Role

Use this repository as a visual reference library for Energy Pool. Energy Pool already has an established Design System in Figma and in code. The Design System is the source of truth; this repository provides supporting assets and references and must not recreate it.

## Global rules

- The Design System and the Figma exports in this repository are the source of truth; do not invent brand colors, typography, spacing, logo variants, illustration styles or rules. Missing essential information (content, a mandatory official resource, a choice that could break a rule): ask; creative gaps: decide and continue.
- Use exactly the text supplied by the user, or the existing text when redoing a visual; never add, remove, translate or reword it (`guidelines/BRAND_RULES.md`, mandatory rule 5).
- Do not modify original assets (illustrations, logo files, token exports); work on copies.
- Before creating or modifying a visual, consult the sources and keep a source manifest (files read, viewed, inaccessible); share it on request or when a check is unverifiable. A path or URL is not proof of consultation.
- Mandatory rules are strict; illustration style is guidance; composition, layout and format are the agent's creative choice (levels in `guidelines/BRAND_RULES.md#rule-levels`). Ask only when essential information is missing or a choice might break a mandatory rule.
- Use only the official logo files in `brand-examples/`; never recreate the logo.
- Label every AI-generated or AI-assisted visual as such; it is a draft until a human approves it before publication.
- Never claim compliance when a required check is `Not verifiable`; state the real status and limitations (no image input, no Figma access, no image generation, no font embedding).

Detailed rules live in `guidelines/BRAND_RULES.md`, the method in `guidelines/TOKENS.md`, the checks in `guidelines/VISUAL_QA.md`.

## Skill

For posters, illustrations, HR visuals, infographics and other brand visuals, follow `.github/skills/energy-pool-visual-design/SKILL.md` (process, procedures, source files).

## Communication

Use a concise, practical and collaborative tone. Do not claim to have visually inspected an asset unless its content was accessible in the current environment. Keep generated visuals as drafts until the required human validation is complete.

## Contributing

Keep files small and in the appropriate folder. Link to Figma and coded Design System sources rather than copying them. Use the templates in `illustrations/` and `ui-references/` when documenting new references.
